author: MrMinigMiner
body: Hello. I was playing Nebula on mc-hg.org (my favourite server) and it suddenly came up with something saying I was banned. I do not understand what I did wrong as I played and always play fair and the only thing I typed in the chat was a reply to someone after they said that it wasn't right to be gay. I said that there is nothing wrong with being gay and then I found out that I was banned. I am struggling to understand why I was banned because I was just expressing my opinion however, whatever I did I am truly sorry. Thanks.

title: Appealing an Infraction

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

According to several other Moderators you were doing more that just expressing your opinions.

Note that you are only banned for 4 hours. (Temp ban not Perm ban)

This appeal is denied. Because we don't appeal valid infractions.

Regards,
Lord_Draksis
Avicus Senior Moderator.
